text:
jordan lee: Vendor sync takeaway: multiple vendors want a single orchestration plan so marketplace flips, SI certs, and press don't step on each other. Asking for a short playbook + explicit embargo windows.
anna kovac: Agree. We should prescribe a stagger: marketplace tag -> SI validation -> press. Recommend 72h between tag publish and press. APAC needs extra firmware sign-off (add 4 business days).
samir choudhury: On capacity, ops suggested a small canary pool per region. We should define numbers now so partners can schedule dryruns.
rachel t: Ops numbers proposal: NA: 80 slots (mix H100/B200), EU: 50, APAC: 30 (more for MI300 work). We'll also carve a dedicated staging VLAN for partner CIDRs.
jordan lee: Draft timeline (editable):
```
- Day -14: compatibility matrix + signed image process published to partners
- Day -10: SI invites + staging ACLs opened
- Day -7 to -3: SI dryruns (regionally phased)
- Day -3: marketplace SKU publish (internal embargo, not public)
- Day 0: press announce window (48-72h notice to press)
- Day +3: canary customers + 72h monitoring window
- Day +10: APAC delayed rollout after firmware certs
```
anna kovac: Legal (EU) requires a 72h pre-embargo PR review. Tag `legal-eu` on PRs and include the risk checklist.
samir choudhury: Routing/fallback note: if H100 nodes exceed thermal or error thresholds, route to B200 or MI300-compat. Suggest automatic fallback when perf drop >12% for 10m. Example config snippet below:
```yaml
routing:
  primary: h100-v4
  fallbacks:
    - b200-lt
    - mi300-compat
  perf_threshold_pct: 12
  window_mins: 10
```
rachel t: SKU semantics: separate SKUs for marketplace-hosted vs signed on-prem images so SIs can validate the exact runtime. I'll draft names.
jordan lee: Proposed SKU names (initial): `H100-v4-market`, `H100-v4-signed`, `H200-v1-market`, `B200-v1-market`, `MI300-v3-signed`, `Gaudi-2.3-market`. We'll put final mapping in the partner SKU sheet.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "HW launch choreography: SI dryruns + SKU gating" on 2026-09-09 08:30 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, ops, legal-eu
anna kovac: Partners asked for a 1-page SI troubleshooting runbook (image verify, kernel logs, docker flags, kv-cache hints). Can someone own this?
samir choudhury: I'll own the runbook. Will include `sha256` verification, `dmesg` greps, example `docker run --gpus` flags, and KV cache warmup notes.
rachel t: Ops action: reserve staging VLANs, carve out per-region canary pools, and create a quick dashboard with thermal, kernel-ooms, and RPC latency at 1m resolution for first 72h.
jordan lee: Action items: @rachel reserve infrastructure + dashboards, @samir draft runbook + routing PR, @anna coordinate legal embargo slot, @partners-bot notify vendors once timelines are locked. Owners update by EOD Friday.
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 5 days before Day -14 start.
anna kovac: One more ask from partners: a short rollback play (revoke marketplace tag, restore previous SKU alias, and notify partners). Can we add a 3-step rollback checklist to the runbook?
samir choudhury: Yes. Will add: 1) revoke tag, 2) restore alias, 3) notify partner and ops, plus postmortem template.
jordan lee: OK if we ship this to vendor PMs tomorrow morning unless anyone objects.
anna kovac: +1
rachel t: +1
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 2 days before calendar event."
